_documentation: PROPOSED — Narrative Knowledge Pack companion sample. This file is NOT a baseline schema and is NOT validated by the AJV/Vitest conformance harness: it lives under fixtures/toy-world/proposed/ which the harness enumerate list (a non-recursive readdirSync of fixtures/toy-world/) never traverses. Do NOT add this file to FIXTURE_SCHEMA_MAP. The KnowledgeEntry / Relation / SourceAnchor atoms embedded below WITHOUT a `modules` property each conform to the committed baseline schemas if validated standalone; the `modules.pack` (pack-level metadata) and `modules.activation` (per-entry fire conditions) objects are proposed companion shapes from the Narrative Knowledge Pack handbook (.mstar/specs/domain-profile-narrative-knowledge-pack.md) and the Lore Activation handbook (.mstar/specs/domain-profile-lore-activation.md). Neither `modules` nor any pack envelope is present on a committed schema; they ship on the wire only after the triad demand gate. Handbooks + this companion are sufficient interchange documentation until then.
